# 端到端: 脏表 -> 清洗 -> 特征 -> 线性回归 -> 指标 -> 灵敏度
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

rng = np.random.default_rng(88)
n = 400

def make_raw():
    area = rng.normal(90, 25, n).round(1)
    rooms = rng.integers(1, 6, n)
    age = rng.integers(0, 40, n).astype(float)
    noise = rng.normal(0, 12, n)
    price = 0.9 * area + 8.0 * rooms - 0.7 * age + 30 + noise          # 万元
    df = pd.DataFrame({"area": area, "rooms": rooms, "age": age, "price": price})
    # 制造脏数据
    df.loc[rng.choice(n, 20, replace=False), "area"] = np.nan           # 缺失
    df.loc[rng.choice(n, 8, replace=False), "area"] = -5.0              # 非法负值
    df.loc[rng.choice(n, 5, replace=False), "age"] = 999.0              # 越界
    df = pd.concat([df, df.iloc[:5]], ignore_index=True)                # 重复行
    return df

raw = make_raw()
print("=== 步骤 1: 质量体检 ===")
print("  行数=%d 列数=%d 完全重复行=%d" % (len(raw), raw.shape[1], int(raw.duplicated().sum())))
print("  缺失率 area=%.2f%% rooms=%.2f%% age=%.2f%% price=%.2f%%"
      % tuple(raw[c].isna().mean() * 100 for c in raw.columns))
print("  area 负值数=%d | age>100 个数=%d" % (int((raw["area"] < 0).sum()), int((raw["age"] > 100).sum())))

print("")
print("=== 步骤 2: 清洗(新增列, 保留原始) ===")
df = raw.drop_duplicates().copy()
df["age_c"] = df["age"].where(df["age"] <= 100)          # 越界置缺失
df["area_c"] = df["area"].where(df["area"] > 0)          # 负值置缺失
df["area_c"] = df["area_c"].fillna(df["area_c"].median())  # 中位数填充
df["age_c"] = df["age_c"].fillna(df["age_c"].median())
print("  清洗后行数=%d" % len(df))
print("  剩余缺失: area_c=%d age_c=%d" % (int(df["area_c"].isna().sum()), int(df["age_c"].isna().sum())))
print("  area_c 均值=%.2f 中位数=%.2f" % (df["area_c"].mean(), df["area_c"].median()))

print("")
print("=== 步骤 3: 特征工程 ===")
df["rooms_per_area"] = df["rooms"] / df["area_c"]
df["is_new"] = (df["age_c"] <= 5).astype(int)
print("  派生 rooms_per_area: 均值=%.5f 标准差=%.5f" % (df["rooms_per_area"].mean(), df["rooms_per_area"].std(ddof=1)))
print("  is_new 计数占比 = %.4f" % df["is_new"].mean())

print("")
print("=== 步骤 4: 划分 + 标准化(fit 只在训练集) ===")
feats = ["area_c", "rooms", "age_c"]
X_all = df[feats].to_numpy()
y_all = df["price"].to_numpy()
idx = rng.permutation(len(df))
n_tr = int(len(df) * 0.7)
tr, te = idx[:n_tr], idx[n_tr:]
mu, sd = X_all[tr].mean(axis=0), X_all[tr].std(axis=0, ddof=1)
Xtr = (X_all[tr] - mu) / sd
Xte = (X_all[te] - mu) / sd
print("  mu =", [round(v, 3) for v in mu])
print("  sd =", [round(v, 3) for v in sd])

print("")
print("=== 步骤 5: 线性回归(最小二乘, 含截距) ===")
A = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(Xtr)), Xtr])
coef, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, y_all[tr], rcond=None)
print("  截距=%.4f" % coef[0])
for name, c in zip(feats, coef[1:]):
    print("  %-8s 系数=%+.4f" % (name, c))

print("")
print("=== 步骤 6: 评价指标(测试集) ===")
def metrics(y, yhat):
    e = y - yhat
    mae = float(np.mean(np.abs(e)))
    rmse = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(e ** 2)))
    r2 = 1 - float(np.sum(e ** 2)) / float(np.sum((y - y.mean()) ** 2))
    return mae, rmse, r2

for label, Xm in (("训练集", Xtr), ("测试集", Xte)):
    yy = y_all[tr] if label == "训练集" else y_all[te]
    Aa = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(Xm)), Xm])
    yh = Aa @ coef
    mae, rmse, r2 = metrics(yy, yh)
    print("  %s MAE=%.4f RMSE=%.4f R2=%.4f" % (label, mae, rmse, r2))

yy = y_all[te]
Ate = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(Xte)), Xte])
yh = Ate @ coef
mae, rmse, r2 = metrics(yy, yh)
base_mae, base_rmse, base_r2 = metrics(yy, np.full(len(yy), y_all[tr].mean()))
print("")
print("  基线(用训练集均值预测) MAE=%.4f RMSE=%.4f R2=%.4f" % (base_mae, base_rmse, base_r2))
print("  模型相对基线 RMSE 降低 %.1f%%" % ((base_rmse - rmse) / base_rmse * 100))

print("")
print("=== 步骤 7: 灵敏度分析(测试集 RMSE 对特征扰动的响应) ===")
sens = []
for k, name in enumerate(feats):
    Xp = Xte.copy()
    Xp[:, k] += 0.1                      # 该特征标准化值 +0.1
    yp = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(Xp)), Xp]) @ coef
    d = float(np.sqrt(np.mean((yy - yp) ** 2))) - rmse
    sens.append((name, d, d / rmse * 100))
    print("  %-8s 标准化值+0.1 -> RMSE 变化 %+.4f (%.3f%%)" % (name, d, d / rmse * 100))
print("")
print("=== 步骤 8: 结论与局限 ===")
print("  1. 模型在测试集上 RMSE=%.3f 万元, 相对基线降低 %.1f%%" % (rmse, (base_rmse - rmse) / base_rmse * 100))
print("  2. 灵敏度排序(按 |RMSE 相对变化|): "
      + " > ".join("%s(%.3f%%)" % (n, abs(p)) for n, _d, p in sorted(sens, key=lambda t: -abs(t[2]))))
print("     系数绝对值排序(标准化后可比): "
      + " > ".join("%s(%.4f)" % (n, abs(c))
                   for n, c in sorted(zip(feats, coef[1:]), key=lambda t: -abs(t[1]))))
print("  3. 局限: 仅 3 个特征且为线性假设; 未做误差分析; 未检验交互项")
print("  4. 若面积缺失非随机(如大户型更不愿披露), 中位数填充会引入偏差")
